An '''abandoned tibanna gas factory''' was located on the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Ord Ibanna]]. It was the site where [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tholme]] and [[Khaleen Hentz/Legends|Khaleen Hentz]] talked about [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] and his decision to not return back to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to complete his mission as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="Jedi: Count Dooku" />
